traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are met with concrete implementation and passing tests: - Core Functionality: The plugin properly registers rules and configs and loads under ESLint, confirmed by unit tests and end-to-end CLI integration tests. - Quality Standards: The structure follows standard ESLint plugin conventions (rules object, recommended/strict configs, flat-config support, peerDependency on eslint v9) and is backed by a full Jest + TypeScript tooling setup. - Integration with ESLint v9 flat config: Verified both programmatically via FlatESLint using the plugin’s `configs.recommended/strict` and via the real ESLint CLI with eslint.config.js. - User Experience: README.md and linked user-docs provide clear installation, configuration, quick-start, validation, and testing instructions for developers. - Error Handling: Dynamic rule loading is robust against failures, logging clear errors and falling back to a placeholder rule; this is thoroughly tested including CLI-level error scenarios. - Documentation: The plugin’s structure, configuration, and development/test workflows are documented in README.md and user-docs. Given this evidence, the story is fully implemented and operational.
